{{rt|20|Unova}} }} '''Legendary Tornadus''' (Japanese: '''VSトルネロスれいじゅうフォルムI''' ''VS {{tt|Tornelos Sacred Beast Forme|Tornadus Therian Forme}} I''), titled '''VS Tornadus Therian Forme I''' in the [[Shogakukan Asia]] translation, is the 532nd chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the eighth chapter of the {{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}. It is subtitled '''Tornadus: Therian Forme I''' (Japanese: '''レジェンダリー・トルネード''' ''Legendary Tornado'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Legendary Tornadus''' in the Shogakukan Asia translation. ==Plot== {{incomplete plot}} Whitley is dreaming about N. She runs up to a silhouette of N in her old Team Plasma outfit. The silhouette tells her to smile and she hugs him. The silhouette praises Whitley for giving him strength. She looks towards the silhouette, confused. The silhouette is revealed to be Blake and she screams. Her dorm room neighbors hear her scream and go to check on her to see if a pervert or Hugh is in her room. She wakes up with all the commotion and tells her neighbors that she had a scary dream. She shuts the door and talks to Foongy about the dream and how she might be falling for Blake and not for N. She then realizes she's lost her pendant of N. ==Major events== * {{adv|Whitley}} realizes that she lost her pendant. * {{adv|Blake}} reveals that [[Giallo]] has been sighted around {{rt|20|Unova}}. * Blake takes {{adv|Whitley}} to Route 20 and has {{adv|Looker}} watch to see how Whitley reacts to Giallo in order to confirm her relation to [[Team Plasma]]. * Blake and Whitley are attacked by {{DL|Forces of nature (Adventures)|Tornadus}}, which proceeds to turn into its Therian Forme. * Blake is revealed to have caught {{p|Keldeo}}, nicknaming it "[[Kelden]]". {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Tornadus}} (Therian Forme) ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Blake}} * {{adv|Whitley}} * {{adv|Looker}} * {{adv|Cheren}} * {{adv|N}} (silhouette; fantasy) * [[Hugh]] * [[Leo]] * [[Giallo]] (photo) * {{adv|Yuki}} * {{adv|Maya}} * {{adv|Yuko}} ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Dewott}} ({{OP|Blake|Dewott}}) * {{p|Keldeo}} ([[Kelden]]; {{adv|Blake}}'s) * {{p|Foongus}} ([[Foongy]]; {{adv|Whitley}}'s) * {{p|Croagunk}} ({{OP|Looker|Croagunk}}) * {{p|Tornadus}} ({{DL|Forces of nature (Adventures)|Tornadus|Team Plasma's}}; both Formes) ==Trivia== {{-}} ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color=EBEBEB|bordercolor=CEB654 |fr=La tornade des légendes |de=VS.
